description: D30 — 无废子典范：每个白棋子都有任务

intro.popup_en:
Piece Coordination, Practice 6
The Queen's Gambit Declined is a classic example of using every piece. White's moves all serve one plan: control the c-file.
intro.popup:
子力协调第6局
后翼弃兵防御（QGD）是无废子的经典教学局
白方每步棋都服务于同一计划：控制c列

outro.popup_en: Summary: Qc2 connects the pieces. Every queenside piece has a role, making this a clear example of coordination.
outro.popup:
总结：Qc2连接所有子力
后翼棋子无一废子——这是一个很好的子力协调范例！

moves.popup: d4占中心
moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center.

moves.popup: d5对抗d4
moves.popup_en: ...d5 challenges White's central pawn.

moves.popup:
c4后翼弃兵！
弃兵开放c列
计划：Rc1控制c列
moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit offers a pawn to open the c-file. White's plan is to control that file with Rc1.

moves.popup:
e6封闭体系
黑方拒绝弃兵，稳固中心
moves.popup_en: ...e6 declines the gambit and reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
Nc3第1支柱
激活：马控d5和e4
协调：Nc3是白方协调体系的枢纽
moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops the first supporting piece: the knight controls d5 and e4 and becomes a hub of White's coordination.

moves.popup: Nf6黑方出马
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a black knight.

moves.popup:
Bg5第2支柱！
激活：象出动牵制Nf6
协调：Bg5限制f6马，使黑方d5得不到充分保护
计划：Bg5+Nc3联合施压d5
moves.popup_en: Bg5! The bishop pins Nf6 and restricts its support of d5. Together with Nc3, it increases pressure on d5.

moves.popup:
Be7黑方守备
黑方象保护f6马
moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops and supports the knight on f6.

moves.popup:
e3稳固
激活：开放c1象有斜线
协调：e3为Bd3的激活做铺垫
moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces the center, opens the c1-bishop's diagonal, and prepares Bd3.

moves.popup: O-O黑方易位
moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.

moves.popup:
Nf3第3支柱
激活：第2个马出动
协调：Nf3（控e5）+ Nc3（控d5）+ Bg5（牵制f6）三子联动
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops the second knight. Nf3 controls e5, Nc3 controls d5, and Bg5 pins Nf6: three pieces working together.

moves.popup:
Nbd7黑方马出动
黑方准备...c6支援d5
moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops and prepares ...c6 to support d5.

moves.popup:
Rc1！！ 最关键一步！
激活：车直接进入战斗位置！
协调：Rc1（控c列）+ Nc3（支援c4）+ Bg5（牵制f6）三子配合
计划：c列是白方的主攻轴线
💡 这步棋证明白方计划从第2步就已确定！
moves.popup_en: Rc1!! A key move: the rook enters the fight on the c-file, coordinating with Nc3's support of c4 and Bg5's pin. White's main attacking axis has been planned since c4.

moves.popup:
c6黑方守d5
黑方巩固中心
moves.popup_en: ...c6 supports d5 and reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
Bd3第4支柱
激活：象到达最佳格
协调：Bd3（象控e4和b5斜线）+ Nf3（守e5）+ Rc1（控c列）
计划：Bd3准备易位后的进攻
moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops the bishop to an ideal square. It controls the e4 and b5 diagonals, works with Nf3 and Rc1, and prepares an attack after castling.

moves.popup:
dxc4黑方吃兵
黑方终于吃c4兵
moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 finally captures the gambit pawn.

moves.popup:
Bxc4象到c4
激活：象控制f7格
协调：Bxc4（象控f1-a6斜线）更加锋利
moves.popup_en: Bxc4 recaptures and places the bishop on an active diagonal toward f7.

moves.popup:
Nd5黑方马冒进
黑方马突入d5
moves.popup_en: ...Nd5 jumps into the center, but the knight may be overextended.

moves.popup:
Bxe7换象！
激活：换掉Be7后，黑方d5马失去后方支撑
协调：换象打乱黑方协调体系
moves.popup_en: Bxe7 exchanges bishops. Once Be7 is gone, Black's knight on d5 loses an important source of support; the exchange disrupts Black's coordination.

moves.popup: Qxe7黑方吃回
moves.popup_en: ...Qxe7 recaptures the bishop.

moves.popup:
O-O白方易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：易位后双车将联合控制
moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and activates the rook on f1. The rooks can now coordinate on the c-file.

moves.popup:
Nxc3黑方换马
黑方换掉Nc3
moves.popup_en: ...Nxc3 exchanges Black's knight for the white knight on c3.

moves.popup:
Rxc3车吃马！
激活：Rc1变成Rc3，车进入c3强格！
协调：Rc3（车控c3-c8）+ Rfc1（待机）= 双车控c列
计划：双车控c列，压力巨大！
moves.popup_en: Rxc3 captures the knight. The rook transfers from c1 to c3, while the other rook can follow to c1: together they control the c-file.

moves.popup:
e5黑方反击
黑方中路爆发
moves.popup_en: ...e5 counterattacks in the center.

moves.popup: dxe5白方吃兵
moves.popup_en: dxe5 captures the pawn.

moves.popup: Nxe5黑方马吃
moves.popup_en: ...Nxe5 recaptures with the knight.

moves.popup:
Nxe5白马吃
大量换子后局面清晰
moves.popup_en: Nxe5 captures the knight. After the exchanges, the position becomes clearer.

moves.popup: Qxe5黑方后上来
moves.popup_en: ...Qxe5 brings Black's queen into the center.

moves.popup:
Qc2！后出动！
激活：后进入c2将所有子力联结
协调终结：
♛ Qc2（连接双车，控c2-h7斜线）
♖ Rc3（控c列）
♖ Rfc1（待机）
协调形成：后+双车控c列，这就是QGD的精髓！
✅ 无废子验证通过！
moves.popup_en: Qc2! The queen joins the c-file plan and connects the rooks. Qc2 supports the c-file force, Rc3 controls the file, and Rfc1 can reinforce it. Queen and two rooks work together: a coordinated QGD setup with no idle pieces.
